summary: Implemented consistent binary classification for managed file-backed Search text sources. The default full-input policy scans decoded characters to EOF with a bounded pooled buffer, treats decoded U+0000 as a skip-and-report marker, avoids UTF-16 encoded-zero false positives, and prevents late-marker files from reaching the matching sink.

review.reviewer: separate grill-code review pass (no independent subagent was available)

implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning Search binary-policy/source/counter implementation, required Search tests and related Search documentation were changed. Existing two-argument SQL constructor metadata remains unchanged; no native backend, sibling repository, release, publication, installation or raw-byte search surface was modified.

binaryPolicy.marker: Decoded U+0000; raw zero bytes are not independently sufficient under UTF-16.
binaryPolicy.validation: Full-input validation through successful EOF or the first decoded marker, using the selected strict UTF-8/UTF-16 mode and no fixed prefix heuristic.
binaryPolicy.decision: skip-and-report; the internal BinaryFilesSkipped counter records policy-selected files for the later terminal-summary surface.
binaryPolicy.lateMarkers: The default file-backed source preflights the complete decoded file and opens it for matching only after a marker-free result, so no row from a late-marker file reaches the sink.
binaryPolicy.resourceBoundary: A bounded pooled character buffer is reused for classification and matching; two passes avoid retaining unbounded candidate rows until EOF.
binaryPolicy.injectedReaders: A supplied TextReader factory is already-decoded input and remains outside this file-byte classification boundary.

requiredCoverage: NUL at the last character of a bounded reader block, the first character of the next block and the following character
UTF-16 little-endian and big-endian BOM text without false positives from encoded zero bytes
Opaque control bytes and binary data containing a valid UTF-8 payload
A late NUL after a matching prefix is skipped before any occurrence row reaches the sink

commands.executionWrapper: Direct PowerShell invocation with separate stdout/stderr capture; product argv is recorded above; captured logs were normalized to UTF-8 LF for deterministic hashing.

commands.argv: git diff --check; JSON parse validation; source and artifact hash validation; campaign validator

gateResults.evidence: The exact owning-repository Release suite exited 0 with 21 projects, 1,404 discovered, 1,370 passed, 0 failed and 34 skips; the focused Search suite exited 0 with 117 passed and 3 expected platform-conditional skips.

The separate ownership review approved the decoded-marker policy, full-input boundary, reader ownership, late-marker behavior and scope boundary; exact commands, tool versions, source/artifact hashes and the unique trailer-bearing completion commit are recorded and verified during post-commit finalization.
Focused tests cover all required binary-policy cases: reader-block marker boundaries, both UTF-16 BOM endiannesses, opaque control bytes and valid UTF-8 binary content with a late marker.

Classification and matching reuse one bounded pooled character buffer; readers are disposed on all paths, cancellation is checked around bounded reads, and the classifier emits no rows or borrowed-buffer state.

knownLimitations: The current public Search SQL constructors remain two-argument and retain their existing defaults; terminal-summary transport and public binary options are later campaign work.
A supplied TextReader factory is already-decoded input and is intentionally outside file-byte classification; arbitrary raw-byte matching remains the separate search.bytes contract.
Preflight and matching use separate file opens and, like existing live-file traversal, do not claim an atomic filesystem snapshot across concurrent replacement.
Invalid non-marker input remains a typed strict source-read failure rather than being reinterpreted as arbitrary binary data.
The repository-wide suite retains 31 expected skips and 3 platform-conditional symlink skips; no package was published.
